# Patient.info

> > Patient.info provides evidence-based medication interaction guides and health information to help patients safely manage their treatments.

Patient.info is a comprehensive health resource offering detailed drug interaction guides, medication safety information, and practical health advice. The site covers interactions between prescription medications (like Atorvastatin, Metformin, Amitriptyline), supplements (St John's Wort, Magnesium, Vitamin D), and natural remedies, helping patients understand risks and safe usage.

## Key Topics

- Drug interactions
- Medication safety
- Side effects monitoring
- Atorvastatin (statins)
- Amitriptyline
- Trazodone
- St John's Wort
- Metformin
- Sertraline
- Blood pressure management
- Supplement safety
- Serotonin syndrome
- Contraceptive effectiveness
- Drowsiness and sedation
- Blood sugar monitoring

## Major Drug Interactions

- [St John's Wort and the Pill: Major Interaction Risk](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/st-john-s-wort-and-contraceptive-pill-interaction): Major risk: St John's Wort reduces contraceptive pill effectiveness
- [Amitriptyline and Trazodone: Major Interaction Warning](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/amitriptyline-and-trazodone-interaction): Major interaction warning: amitriptyline-trazodone serotonin syndrome risk
- [Tizanidine and Trazodone: Drug Interaction & Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/tizanidine-and-trazodone-interaction): Tizanidine-trazodone risks: severe drowsiness & low blood pressure warning
- [Pyridostigmine and Ramipril Drug Interaction Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/pyridostigmine-and-ramipril-interaction): Pyridostigmine-ramipril risks: angioedema & low blood pressure warning

## Antidepressant and Mental Health Medication Interactions

- [Metformin and Sertraline: Interaction and Monitoring Advice](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/metformin-and-sertraline-interaction): Metformin-sertraline interaction: blood sugar monitoring & hypoglycaemia risks
- [Venlafaxine and Vitamin D: Is it Safe to Take Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/venlafaxine-and-vitamin-d-interaction): Venlafaxine-vitamin D interaction: generally safe combination guidance
- [Amitriptyline and Colecalciferol: Interaction Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/amitriptyline-and-colecalciferol-interaction): Amitriptyline-colecalciferol (vitamin D3) interaction safety guidance

## Cardiovascular and Cholesterol Medication Interactions

- [Atorvastatin and Fibre: Managing the Interaction](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/atorvastatin-and-fibre-supplements-interaction): Atorvastatin-fibre interaction guide: timing doses for effective treatment
- [Atorvastatin and Biotin: Is it Safe to Take Them Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/atorvastatin-and-biotin-interaction): Atorvastatin-biotin: no known interaction, safe to combine
- [Losartan and Pregabalin: Side Effects and Safety Advice](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/losartan-and-pregabalin-interaction): Losartan-pregabalin interaction: dizziness, blood pressure & swelling risks
- [Levothyroxine and Prednisolone: Drug Interaction Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/levothyroxine-and-prednisolone-interaction): Levothyroxine-prednisolone interaction: thyroid level monitoring guidance

## Pain Management Medication Interactions

- [Ibuprofen Gel and Shortec: Safety and Interaction Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/ibuprofen-and-oxycodone-interaction): Ibuprofen gel-Shortec (oxycodone) safety guide for pain relief combination
- [Lansoprazole and Tramadol: Interaction & Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/lansoprazole-and-tramadol-interaction): Lansoprazole-tramadol combination: generally safe with minor side effects
- [Lactulose and Naproxen: Is It Safe to Take Them Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/lactulose-and-naproxen-bp-interaction): Lactulose-naproxen safety: hydration advice for combined use

## Supplement and Natural Remedy Interactions

- [Ashwagandha and Magnesium: Can They Be Taken Together?](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/ashwagandha-and-magnesium-interaction): Ashwagandha-magnesium interaction: nervous system relaxation effects
- [Folic Acid and St John's Wort: Interaction Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/folic-acid-and-st-john-s-wort-interaction): Folic acid-St John's Wort: safe combination with minimal interaction
- [Glucosamine and Magnesium: Interaction and Safety Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/glucosamine-and-magnesium-interaction): Glucosamine-magnesium supplement combination safety guidance

## Gastrointestinal Medication Interactions

- [Lansoprazole and Rivaroxaban: Drug Interaction Guide](https://patient.info/medication-interactions/lansoprazole-and-rivaroxaban-interaction): Lansoprazole-rivaroxaban combination: safe with no significant interaction
